ModMetaData.name: Armor Integrity
ModMetaData.author: PhillipFrei
ModMetaData.description: Armor Integrity 1.0 for RimWorld 1.6. Armor is processed from outer to inner using RimWorld/Armored Up layer order. Every armor-relevant hit uses Sharp armor, wears armor by Damage × AP / current AR, and forwards remaining damage and AP through penetrated or exhausted layers. Apparel loses real HP with fractional wear preserved; intrinsic armor uses regenerating Battered. Includes a single armor-integrity bar.
